subject: Hosted API fit & rate caps — endpoints, quickstart, and next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme-platform.com>, Michael Liu <m.liu@acme-platform.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API fit & rate caps — endpoints, quickstart, and next steps

Hi Sara / Michael —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and three items for us to align on so we can spin up a Hosted eval that maps to your production needs: 

1) Deployment preference: you mentioned wanting Hosted as long as we can guarantee EU data residency and an SSO/SCIM integration. Please confirm whether EU-only endpoints + SOC2 attestation are sufficient, or if you will require a Private/VPC eval.

2) Traffic profile & rate caps: could you confirm expected peak RPS and average request size (tokens) per call? For example, is the product likely to see 200 RPS bursts with 12–18 token/kb prompts? That will determine if we recommend default Hosted with burst capacity or Reserved Dedicated.

3) Quickstart items: attached is a one-page quickstart checklist (quickstart-checklist.pdf) and I’ve added the demo recording to our Drive link. If you’re comfortable, we can provision trial API keys scoped to eu-west1 and a small burst quota for two weeks.

Next steps I propose:
- You share the short traffic numbers above (RPS, concurrent users, typical prompt+response token sizes)
- We provision a Hosted trial in eu-west1 and give you a temporary quota (no credit card required)
- Follow-up sync early next week to review results and discuss Dedicated/VPC thresholds if needed

Attachments: quickstart-checklist.pdf, demo-recording.mp4

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that’s easier.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme-platform.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Liu <m.liu@acme-platform.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API fit & rate caps — endpoints, quickstart, and next steps

Diego —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Residency/Compliance: EU-only endpoints + SOC2 is our baseline. We may need a Private proof for certain customers later, but for initial eval Hosted EU is preferred.

- Traffic profile (estimate): our target product launches in Q2 and we expect peak bursts ~150–250 RPS during marketing spikes, sustained averages around 30–50 RPS. Typical prompt length ~400–800 tokens; responses averaging 300–600 tokens.

- Authentication: we need support for OIDC SSO for the console and API keys scoped per team.

I’ve attached our security questionnaire with a few items flagged (security-questions.docx). Can you confirm whether rate limits are per-key, per-account, or per-region for Hosted evals? Also curious about default timeout behavior and recommended retry patterns for 5xx/429 responses.

Happy to do the trial — can you provision the EU keys and share the onboarding steps?

Thanks,
Sara Jones
Head of Product | Acme Platform
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme-platform.com>, Michael Liu <m.liu@acme-platform.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API fit & rate caps — endpoints, quickstart, and next steps

Sara — great details, thank you. Answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

- Residency/Compliance: we can provision a Hosted eval in eu-west1. SOC2 Type II report is available under our Compliance portal; I’ll share link after this thread. Private/VPC is an option later if you need network isolation.

- Rate limits: for Hosted evals we enforce per-key rate limits by default. For your target profile we can open an elevated burst window (150–300 RPS) for the two-week trial. Production patterns that require consistent high sustained RPS are typically moved to Dedicated.

- Timeouts & retries: default request timeout is 60s. Recommended client pattern: exponential backoff with jitter for 429s and 5xx, immediate small retry for transient 502/504 up to 2 attempts. We’ll provide an SDK snippet in the quickstart to demonstrate best-practice retry.

- Token guidance: with prompt+response totals in the 700–1,400 token range, we recommend starting with our 8k context model (default) and we can run a short eval to measure latency.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll create an eu-west1 Hosted trial with two API keys (team-scoped + admin) and an elevated burst quota.
2) Monica (cc’d) will kick off a short onboarding runbook and share the hosted-endpoints-specs.md that lists region endpoints, auth flows, and sample cURL/SDK commands.
3) You complete the security-questions.docx where highlighted so our security team can pre-check anything that would push you to Private.

Links/attachments: hosted-endpoints-specs.md, trial-invite-link.txt

If that works I’ll provision later today.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Sara / Michael —

Welcome — Monica here from Customer Success. I’m setting up the onboarding runbook and will provision the eu-west1 trial keys once you confirm the target test dataset and who on your side should receive the admin key. A couple logistic items: 

- Please confirm the two email addresses for the admin + observer keys.
- If you want us to attach a default ratecap policy, choose either (A) 300 RPS burst with 60 RPS sustained or (B) 200 RPS burst with 40 RPS sustained. We recommend Policy A for marketing spikes.
- I’ll schedule a 30-min check-in on Mon 19 Jan to review initial telemetry and any tokenization/latency anomalies.

I’ve pasted Diego’s provisioning checklist below for convenience and attached the hosted-endpoints-specs.md in the Drive link.
